transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?

Hi. Well, I’m here because... for almost two years now, I’ve been dealing with a situation at work, and it's really starting to wear on me. I'm a music director, and right after a big commission we did, I've just been unable to shake the certainty that a few people in the ensemble are quietly trying to undermine my work. 

They do it through things like sudden schedule changes, weird seating choices, or just these little targeted comments during rehearsals. And, you know, even when they show me emails or rehearsal notes that supposedly explain why things were changed... I just know what they're actually doing.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people couldn't hear?

No, no, nothing like that. I mean, I've never heard voices or sounds that aren't there. It's not... I'm not hearing things. It's just the actual, real things they are doing during rehearsals that I'm talking about. My hearing is perfectly fine.

No, not really. It's strictly about work. Outside of this whole issue with the ensemble, I'm doing fine. I mean, I still meet all my deadlines, I keep up with my composing... I even go for a run most mornings. And things at home with my wife are basically steady. So, yeah, I don't have trouble trusting people in general. It's just those specific individuals at work.
